name: Unidentified B1 battle droid 1 (Kiros)
description: This B1 battle droid was stationed on the planet of Kiros and participated in the Battle of Kiros in 20 BBY. Under the command of Darts D'Nar, he guarded a thermal annihilator bomb on Kiros along with two other B1-series battle droids and a group of B2-series super battle droids. However, this droid was destroyed along with his fellow droids by Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano on AT-RTs.
